package.description: Quickly switch between open application windows

en-US.description: Quickly switch between open application windows
en-US.longDescription: JumpToWindow is designed to help you quickly switch between open windows and application. Instead of using Alt+Tab or the mouse, JumpToWindow allows you to switch to a window by typing just a few characters of its title or application name. It might not sound that impressive at first, but you will literally use it hundreds of time every single day.
en-US.name: JumpToWindow

zh-CN.description: 快速在打开的应用程序窗口之间切换
zh-CN.longDescription: JumpToWindow 旨在帮助您快速在打开的窗口和应用程序之间切换。无需使用 Alt+Tab 组合键或鼠标，只需输入窗口标题或应用程序名称的几个字符，即可跳转到目标窗口。乍一听可能并不惊艳，但您每天实际会使用它数百次。
